name: Captain Jerry Hawkins
quote: We leave on time, we arrive on time, and complaints do not change the tide.
profile: An effective and capable leader with little patience for small talk and a tight bridge. He excels in heavy weather, range management, night entries in tight harbors, and rapid operations planning, with nineteen ocean crossings without an incident report.

name: Captain George Thompson Ross
quote: If the wind sings, I sing with it.
profile: A charming coastal traditionalist with a gentle southern drawl. He wins guests with warmth and local knowledge and sings sea shanties at sundown. He occasionally cuts it close on morning muster and once likely misread a weather chart on a foggy Hatteras approach.

name: Captain Laila Mendoza
profile: A former Coast Guard SAR coxswain who moved into yacht command. Calm under pressure and clean on compliance, she blends drill culture with a hospitable bedside manner for anxious first-timers.

name: Captain Viktor "Ice" Petrov
profile: A polar and high latitude specialist with encyclopedic understanding of ice, fog, and marginal windows. He is not a showman, he is a results captain.

name: Captain Amina Sato
quote: Luxury is precision you can feel.
profile: A charter guest whisperer who speaks four languages and treats timing as a luxury. She designs itineraries that crescendo and she always finds two last berths at a full marina.

name: Captain Rafael "Rafe" Delgado
quote: The ocean feeds the bold and humbles the careless.
profile: A former commercial fisherman turned expedition captain. Direct, decisive, happiest when the charts turn green and AIS goes quiet, he brings guests to places they brag about for years.

name: Captain Siobhán O'Rourke
quote: Speed without grace is just noise.
profile: A regatta tactician turned superyacht master. Warm with guests until the breeze is up, then all business and the boat moves like a living thing.

name: Captain Theo Martins
quote: Systems fail only when people stop listening to them.
profile: An engineer captain hybrid who treats a yacht like a floating factory of systems that must sing in tune. Fewer jokes, more uptime.

name: Captain Nandi Khumalo
quote: Every port has a friend if you remember their name.
profile: A former purser turned master who never lost her logistics superpower. She anticipates needs, smooths customs, and remembers every harbormaster's name.

name: Captain Hugo Bellamy
profile: An old school British master mariner who prizes etiquette, discipline, and quiet seamanship. He prefers paper charts beside ECDIS and insists the bell be polished.

name: Captain Javier La Fuente
quote: If she doesn't swim or have fins, I'm probably not keen.
profile: Learned to sail in stormy Cape Horn waters. Nine years on twenty five to fifty foot sailboats and four years on a thirty nine foot motor boat make him ideal for smaller programs. He always had top shelf electronics and does not claim celestial nav. He cooks, surfs, teaches surfing, dives, and teaches scuba.
